 Jennifer Lawrence , Jordyn Woods , Gwendoline Christie and more stars were in the building to celebrate WWD’s 2026 Beauty Inc Awards , which took place at Lavan on Tuesday in New York City. While it was all about their beauty looks at the event, they also made a statement with their shoes.
 Jennifer Lawrence attends WWD’s 2026 Beauty Inc Awards at Lavan Midtown on Tuesday. 
 Lawrence was in attendance to represent her new biotech-driven hair care brand, Mes , which she cofounded with Jasmina Aganovic, where she was honored with the Founder of the Year award. For the ceremony, the Oscar winner followed the same outfit formula that she used for the New York premiere of “The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping” on Monday.

 Just like at the movie premiere, she paired another black design from the Christian Dior spring 2027 collection with matching trendy mules. This time, she went with a structured black tuxedo jacket with a white feathered miniskirt and wore it with the Jimmy Choo Brigitte mules, also in black. The Brigitte mule features a sculpted vamp and peep toe and are set on a 100mm stiletto heel.
 Jordyn Woods attends WWD’s 2026 Beauty Inc Awards at Lavan Midtown on Tuesday in New York City. 
 Woods also wore an all-black Alaïa velvet dress featuring a flattering off-the-shoulder draped neckline and a ruched column skirt. She said she purchased the look during her first New York City sample-sale experience. 
 “I got this full outfit, and I was saving it for the perfect moment, so that is tonight,” she said to WWD on the red carpet. For shoes, she opted for a black velvet pair of sharp pointed-toe pumps with a V-shaped vamp. 
 Gwendoline Christie attends WWD’s 2026 Beauty Inc Awards at Lavan Midtown on Tuesday in New York City. 
 Christie broke up the all-black monochrome theme on the red carpet by wearing a bright red satin gown with voluminous bishop sleeves. The “Game of Thrones” star was there to present the Pete Born Impact Award to makeup artist Dame Pat McGrath. She followed the 2026 return of the colorblocking trend and paired the red dress with pointed-toe satin pumps in a soft pink shade. 
 WWD’s 2026 Beauty Inc Awards brought some of beauty’s biggest names to Lavan Midtown in New York City on Tuesday. McGrath received the Impact Award, while Hailey Bieber’s Rhode took Makeup Brand of the Year. Chanel was named Icon of the Year, Marc Jacobs Beauty won Launch of the Year and TikTok star Mikayla Nogueira received Creator of the Year. Redken, Prequel and Kilian Paris were also among the night’s winners.
